message:
feat: release 0.10.0 with MathJSLab 2.10 numeric sessions

Expose copied numeric Worker session options and optional reset, preserving document isolation, diagnostic codes and host plot lifecycle. Preserve exact parser terminators and suppress final semicolon values while retaining load and plot effects.

Use the published MathJSLab 2.10 optional peer and matching development dependency. Update renderer/build dependencies and distribute the Leaflet types referenced by public declarations. Record development-only audit findings and refresh API, lifecycle and integration documentation.

Preserve pinned HDL assets and source reproduction evidence, include the current teaching catalogue improvements, and align cold chapter test budgets. Validate unit/distribution tests, real browser Workers, renderers, HDL runtimes and an isolated installed archive. Advance package and lockfile to 0.10.0.
